gaps.criterion: A visitor can navigate home, product, how it works, security, pilot programme, about and FAQ pages from a shared header and footer on desktop and mobile
gaps.gap: Desktop navigation is covered by tests/features/website.feature (9 synced scenarios). Mobile (390px, menu button) passed in an ad-hoc Playwright run but is not in a committed artifact; the Test MCP runs one viewport, so a mobile-viewport portal or scenario is still needed.

gaps.criterion: Every page sets its own title and description metadata and meets WCAG 2.1 AA for headings, landmarks, contrast and keyboard focus
gaps.gap: Verified ad hoc: axe-core WCAG 2.1 A/AA rules report 0 violations on all 8 routes at 1280px and 390px (including colour contrast); one h1 and one main per page; per-page title and description; skip link is the first tab stop. Not yet asserted by a committed runner (the website feature only checks visible text).
